__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod.
JoinRange: cells around a town where NPCs come to its market.
SellerJoinMarketRate / BuyerJoinMarketRate: chances in % a month (S&M MarketItemNpcJoinRate on top).
SellRateDependOnGrade: chance in % that a seller puts up an item = (7 - item level) x this. BuyRateDependOnGrade: chance in % of a bid = item level x this.
GetDealRate: chance in % a month of a deal = this x best bid / price. CancelDealOnMonth: chance in % a month that the seller takes the item back = this x months on sale.
CancelDealLastMinuteRate, HiddenRate (seller hides the name), GetStalkedRate (S&M MarketItemGetAttackedRate on top): chances in %.
